svg.text: • Full commands only — no abbreviations (sh, conf t rejected) 只认写全的命令，不认缩写

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • Forbidden verbs checked before allowed ones 先查禁令再查放行

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • One optional pipe: include / exclude / begin / section / count 管道后只允许这五个过滤词

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • No shell metacharacters, control chars or non-ASCII; ≤ 200 chars 拒绝元字符、控制字符、非 ASCII，≤ 200 字符

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • ping / traceroute off unless explicitly enabled ping / traceroute 默认关闭

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • On IOS a low privilege level is not a boundary if `enable` has no secret.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: IOS 上 enable 没设 secret 时，低权限等级不是边界。

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • Verify on a real VTY that write commands are refused.

svg.text: 在真实 VTY 上验证写命令确实被拒。
